basic_info.description: Located on the 7th floor of the elegant Marlow at 1788 Clay Street, this sophisticated one-bedroom, one-bath condo offers breathtaking views of Russian Hill from both the main living area and the bedroom.: Equipped with stainless steel appliances, including a Bosch oven, Bosch dishwasher, and Whirlpool refrigerator. Convenient laundry facilities right in your home.Features a shower over tub. Beautiful hardwood floors throughout the unit add warmth and elegance to the space. Enjoy peace of mind with a secure building featuring a lovely lobby.  The Marlow offers a common area garden with a BBQ area, sitting area, and bocce ball court, perfect for entertaining or relaxing.
